ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #5
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on Knowledge? (1 mark)
   A. Say Hadith on Knowledge has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Hadith on Knowledge to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Hadith on Knowledge with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on Knowledge.

2. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Hiding stolen items
   B. Spreading rumours
   C. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   D. Cheating in exams

3. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Surah:? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Selected Surah: with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Selected Surah: to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Selected Surah: has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected Surah:.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Belief in Prophets 3.3.1 Qualities of Prophets? (1 mark)
   A. Use Belief in Prophets 3.3.1 Qualities of Prophets to insult classmates of other faiths.

   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Belief in Prophets 3.3.1 Qualities of Prophets.
   D. Say Belief in Prophets 3.3.1 Qualities of Prophets has no place in daily life.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on Gratitude? (1 mark)
   A. Say Hadith on Gratitude has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Hadith on Gratitude to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on Gratitude.
   D. Apply the teaching of Hadith on Gratitude with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

7. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   B. Pollute rivers deliberately
   C. Waste food daily
   D. Destroy trees without planting

8. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on Greetings? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Hadith on Greetings with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Hadith on Greetings has no place in daily life.

   D. Use Miracles of Prophets to insult classmates of other faiths.

10. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   B. Skipping all moral lessons
   C. Refusing to help a neighbour
   D. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

11. Which response best shows understanding of Taraweeh and Witr? (1 mark)
   A. Use Taraweeh and Witr to insult classmates of other faiths.

   D. Say Taraweeh and Witr has no place in daily life.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Belief in Allah 3.1.1 Attributes of Allah: Forgiver) Knowing) Protector) Living)? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Belief in Allah 3.1.1 Attributes of Allah: Forgiver) Knowing) Protector) Living) with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on good Behaviour.

----
16. In three clear sentences, explain Hadith on good Behaviour and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
